story_headline: Lose the signal, keep the map.
post_headline: The map lives on your phone.
post_subline: The whole map is stored on your iPhone or iPad. It still works in airplane mode.
caption:

The whole map lives on your iPhone or iPad, so it keeps working in airplane mode.
